BTC.note: Binance hack: an exchange breach, not Bitcoin itself; 95% covered, withdrawals reopened
BTC.detail: Binance (an exchange) lost about US$6.3bn on 29-30 Oct; the FBI says North Korea did it. It was not a flaw in Bitcoin. Binance says it has covered about 95% of losses (all BTC fully backed) and reopened withdrawals in phases on 1 Nov, starting with Bitcoin; a verifiable reserves proof is expected around 3 Nov. The attacker's 18,270 stolen BTC remain unmoved, so watch for any selling. Separately, Bitcoin Core fixed medium-severity node memory bugs (CVE-2026-117349/117350) in 29.5/30.4/31.2/32.1; no funds at risk. Quantum: new estimates remain theoretical.

TSLA.detail: No confirmed Tesla breach. A Sept 2026 hacking-forum claim is unverified.

MSTR.detail: Strategy itself was not hacked. The Binance hack only moved its share price through Bitcoin.

SEMI.detail: No breaches at SEMI's top holdings. Intel's Israel factory explosion is an operations issue, not a security one.
